To use ohun for auto detection, use reference annotations and either template or energy based detection

Consider using detections from sighted recordings for reference annotations, and then applying to hiceas2010, hiceas2017 (see [here](https://youtu.be/dYlkDCUTbAs?si=jeakjBXvzHeyjC5z&t=1318))


see code here: https://github.com/eco4cast/Statistical-Methods-Seminar-Series
